input.notes:
Whole piece: B&W sports documentary, letterboxed ~2.40:1, grain, vignette; spoken-word intro over a sparse bed, trap drop at 7.64 s (808 on every bar downbeat), ~94.8 BPM.
0–1 s: fade up from black. Hooded athlete walks toward camera out of a dark concrete tunnel, low angle, hard top light; hands reach in from frame edges (crowd). Slight push/roll. Small bold white caps on chest "WORD ONE" (f12) -> "WORD TWO" (f22), hard on/off, Oswald-ish, faint bloom.
1–2 s: cut at f32 (missed by detector) to three players from behind walking toward a lit tunnel exit; italic serif aside "who I was." lower-centre, white. Locked, slight drift.
2–3 s: cut f62 to extreme close-up profile silhouette against bright soft window (face on left half); giant translucent grey numeral "30" across it (Anton, ~0.45 cap, 40% opacity). Locked.
3–4 s: numeral holds; cut f92 to high-key overcast wide: man by an old car in an empty lot, numeral fades out across the cut. He walks slowly forward.
4–5 s: lot wide continues; cut f108 to silhouette profile in front of blown-out tunnel exit (crowd blurred), small caps "MY reference" faint.
5–6 s: cut f122: from behind, forearm on cinderblock wall, head bowed, jersey 30 visible, hard side light; caps "MY reference" -> "WAS TO GO OUT" (f130). Slow push.
6–7 s: cut f146 grinning face close-up, italic serif "and win."; cut f158 to extreme side face push-in, gold Anton "WORD THREE." with amber glow, low-centre, large.
7–8 s: gold line holds through push-in; f184 one-frame RGB-split glitch (title "WIN" glitching) on the drop (7.667 s); f185 dunk under arena lights, low angle, everything grey except blue jersey (keepColor); huge translucent blue "WIN" (Anton, ~0.45) holds across cuts.
8–9 s: f198 cut to ball through net close-up, B&W, bright specular lights, slight punch; f214 blue duotone face close-up; pulse flash f215.
9–10 s: f220 arms raised to roaring crowd from behind (WIN leaves ~f222); cut f226 (missed) cold stare close-up B&W; white wash f234-235 into muted-colour (bleach) celebration of three men in locker room.
10–11 s: celebration continues; f244 one-frame light-blue wash; f245 posterised blue duotone net close-up with slight roll/push; f260 high-key desert with dead trees, lone golfer swinging (practice motion).
11–12 s: swing finishes; f274 pensive man in plane seat by window (B&W); f280 blue duotone, hands over head in front of a bright window.
12–13 s: f288 warm muted memory, laughing with trophy at home (lamp); f294 black Anton "WORD FOUR." on light grey card with heavy vignette, slight zoom-out; f304 posterised blue two-tone dunk from below.
13–14 s: posterised dunk holds; f320 chest-up B&W portrait, white tank, dark blurred arena, still.
14–15 s: f336 empty dark gym, player hanging on rim, jersey kept blue; f342 (missed) studio mic, shirtless, side light; f348 (missed) triptych: three portrait panels on grey, revealed left->right at f348, f352, f358 (stare / cold stare / hands over head).
15–16 s: triptych holds; f366 kneeling alone with ball in an empty arena, B&W, low angle; f380 white wash (2 frames) into gold duotone net with amber bloom (dunk).
16–17 s: gold net + ball through; f396 tight embrace close-up, sweaty arm over shoulder; f402 press-conference laugh (B&W).
17–18 s: f410 team with four trophies, muted colour, giant translucent numeral "4"; f426 one-frame RGB glitch of the practice wide; f427 lone shooter in a dark empty arena from behind the rim, pool of light — held as the breath (to 19.0 s).
18–19 s: practice wide holds, barely moving; ball arcs.
19–20 s: f456 chest-up portrait with giant translucent "WORD FIVE" behind the subject (matte), micro caption "THE SHOT · 2016" under; f472 dribble move with horizontal motion blur, jersey kept blue.
20–21 s: f484 gold "GOOD!" glitches in (RGB) over arms-wide-to-roaring-crowd from behind, holds; f502 one-frame bright blue duotone spray face; f503 blue duotone water spray hitting a laughing face.
21–22 s: spray continues; f516 handheld shaky embrace close-up (sweat); f524 frozen 2x2 recap grid (dunk/roar side/laugh/trophy memory).
22–23 s: f530 roar looking up from low angle; f534 (missed jump cut) crash zoom ~2x into the roaring mouth with shake and blur to f547; f548 practice in dark gym, players in pinnies, micro caption "THE TITLE · 2022".
23–24 s: practice continues, slow drift right; caption at bottom centre.
24–25 s: f578-579 two full-white frames (missed insert); f580 flex and roar to sky, dark ground; f592 embrace in the arena, crowd and rim behind.
25–26 s: embrace holds; f608 grey wash (missed cut) into arms-raised back view, blue jersey kept, grey around; name "The Athlete." upright Playfair fades in behind the shoulders (~f615) with a tiny tracked tagline "WORD SIX" below (~f627).
26–27 s: holds; fade to black from ~f640, black by f646.
27–27.4 s: black tail.
Audio: spoken word 0–7.6 s over sparse pads; drop at 7.64 s with heavy 808 on every bar downbeat (~2.53 s), hats; loudness up ~15 dB; music runs to the end and decays in the black tail.

content.text:
The edit is delivered, but with fewer animated shots than planned: the Comfy Cloud workspace ran out of credits partway through generation. Three of the six clips couldn't be made, so those moments are still images moved with zooms, pans and handheld drift.

**File:** `deliver/iron-mindset-athlete-edit_v1.mp4` (27.4 s, 1920×1080, 24 fps, 44 MB). It's a black-and-white basketball film on the reference's music and cut timing. It moves from him walking out of a dark tunnel, through doubt against a wall, to a dunk on the drop, and ends with his arms raised to the crowd.

**Lines I wrote:**
- Intro: NOBODY / WATCHED / *the early mornings.* / a giant 5AM / EVERY DAY / I CHOSE THE WORK / *and kept going,* / NO DAYS OFF.
- On the drop: a large translucent blue **IRON**.
- Mid-film: UNBREAKABLE. / a translucent 1 over the trophy shot / FOCUS / EARNED!
- Captions: THE QUIET YEARS · 2024 and THE NEXT CHAPTER · 2026.
- Closing card: *Built in the Dark.* with ONWARD underneath. I don't know his name, so this is the film's title rather than the name card the preset expects.

**What was generated:** 13 keyframes, all checked against his face glasses, plus 3 clips: the stare that breaks into a grin and laugh, the dunk, and an earlier test. In the dunk, the ball floats back into his hand from 1.0–2.4 s, so the edit doesn't use that stretch. The music is the reference track, and nothing from the reference footage is reused. He wears a plain royal-blue kit with no logos or numbers, and the blue stays in colour in the otherwise grey action shots. Two keyframes were re-made: one came out as a different man, the other copied the reference's jersey number and caption. Compute used was about 14 of your 25 GPU minutes.

**Known flaws:**
- **Missing clips:** the slide down the wall, the arms-raised victory and the roar are stills, because the account has no credits left. The two cut-outs that put words behind him couldn't run either, so FOCUS and the closing card sit in front of him.
- **Weaker likeness in the roar shots:** glasses show, but in black and white the face reads heavier-jawed than his photo.
- **Practice wide:** his face is too small there to judge the likeness.
- **Basketball:** there are faint printed marks on the ball in the net close-ups.

Once you add credits, the three clips and two cut-outs can be generated (about 9 GPU minutes) and dropped into the same edit.

You can change wording, timing or shots in the editor: http://127.0.0.1:59589/?project=20261017-iron-mindset-athlete-edit-5591
